title: Store Overview
bullets: View Store performance, sales summaries, and operational alerts.
Open dashboard links to review cash variances, pending Stock Issues, and Fiscal Periods.

title: Store Staff
bullets: View staff accounts, assigned roles, and account status.
Add or update staff information and manage operational access.

title: Registers
bullets: View available Registers and their current status.
Manage Register names, receipt paper widths, and availability.

title: Store Settings
bullets: View operational thresholds and review limits for the Store.
Update the required values and select Save settings.

title: Store Calendar
bullets: View the Store calendar and daily operating statuses.
Record open days, closures, holidays, and exceptional closures.

title: Fiscal Periods
bullets: View and create Fiscal Periods for Store records.
Review outstanding responsibilities before closing or locking a period.

title: Promotions
bullets: View and manage Store discounts and promotions.
Set the promotion scope, discount, minimum quantity, and active dates.

title: GCash Overview
bullets: View recorded service cash, wallet balances, and GCash activity.
Review transactions, closing checks, and unresolved exchanges.

title: Cashier Shifts
bullets: View Cashier Shift records, sales, drawer counts, and cash differences.
Filter by date, Cashier, or Register to review the relevant shift.

title: Database Backup
bullets: Create and download an encrypted copy of Store records.
Use a passphrase of at least 16 characters and keep it separately; lost passphrases cannot be recovered.

title: Generate Report
bullets: View sales and other available Store reports.
Choose the report and filters, then run, export, or print the results.

title: Operational Audit
bullets: View recorded Store actions, users, modules, and timestamps.
Search the history and open details to trace an operational event.

title: Receipt History
bullets: View completed Store receipts and related refund information.
Filter the list and open Full details to review the selected receipt.

title: Refund Correction Reviews
bullets: Review corrections needed after a recorded refund.
Approve the exact cash or stock changes and assign the responsible staff.

title: Stock Overview
bullets: View stock totals, low-stock alerts, and expiry information.
Use the overview to identify products that need attention.

title: Products
bullets: View product names, prices, stock levels, and status.
Add or update products and manage their barcode and packaging details.

title: Replenishment Recommendations
bullets: View suggested buying quantities based on stock rules and available forecasts.
Use recommendations as buying guidance; an unavailable forecast does not mean zero demand.

title: Stock Receiving
bullets: Record bought goods using the product catalog or barcode search.
Review quantities, costs, and batch details before saving accepted stock.

title: Receiving History
bullets: View the stock receipts available to your account.
Search recorded entries and open their details to review received quantities.

title: Inventory Counts
bullets: Record physical product or batch counts and the reason for a discrepancy.
Review pending counts before approval; stock changes only after approval.

title: Stock Issue Reviews
bullets: View Stock Issues submitted for Inventory Manager review.
Check the reported goods and record the appropriate decision and notes.

title: Supplier Pullouts
bullets: Record goods removed from a selected product batch.
Enter the actual quantity and reason, then review the pullout history.

title: Demand Forecast
bullets: View available product demand estimates and forecast status.
Check the forecast period and readiness before using estimates for planning.

title: Forecast Exceptions
bullets: View products whose forecast results need further review.
Use the exception filters to identify the affected products and reasons.

title: Data Readiness
bullets: View whether product history is ready for forecasting.
Identify products needing more history or further data review.

title: Insights & Risk
bullets: View inventory risks, including excess stock, expiry exposure, and slow-moving goods.
Use the analysis and cycle-count information to prioritize stock checks.

title: Generate Report
bullets: View the reports available in the Inventory workspace.
Select the report and filters, then review or export its results.

title: Refund Correction Reviews
bullets: View stock correction tasks assigned after an Administrator review.
Record the approved stock action and notes while preserving the original refund.

title: Cashier Shift
bullets: Open a shift using an available Register and the actual starting cash.
Review drawer movements and count cash before closing the shift.

title: Point of Sale
bullets: Scan or search products, review quantities, and complete customer sales.
Open a Cashier Shift before checkout and print the receipt after a successful sale.

title: GCash
bullets: Record Cash-In and Cash-Out exchanges, fees, and reference numbers.
Verify actual wallet and cash movements, then reconcile or hand over service funds.

title: Dashboard Overview
bullets: View daily sales, transaction totals, stock alerts, and recent activity.
Use the Cashier and GCash tabs to review the corresponding summaries.

title: Cash Refunds
bullets: Find the original sale and record returned quantities, item condition, and the refund reason.
Only Restockable items return to available stock; complete the required payment verification and approvals.

title: Transaction History
bullets: View your sales, Cash Refunds, drawer movements, and shifts.
Choose a history tab and date range to find the relevant record.

title: Receipt History
bullets: View the receipts available to your Cashier account.
Open a saved receipt to review or print it without repeating the sale.

title: Report Stock Issue
bullets: Report damaged, missing, expired, or other affected stock during an open shift.
Identify the product, stock form, quantity, and explanation for Inventory Manager review.

title: Refund Correction Reviews
bullets: View cash correction tasks assigned after an Administrator review.
Record the approved drawer action and required notes without rewriting the original refund.

title: Notifications
bullets: View notifications and unread items for your account.
Open the related record to review any action that needs attention.
